title: 英文簡報從開場到收尾
subtitle: 12 句英文，上台不再只會說「呃」

thumb.tag: 開場・路標・問答・收尾

lines.say: Em… hello. My name is Ting. Today I… em… I will… talk about… our project. Sorry.
lines.zh: 呃……大家好，我叫小婷。今天我……呃……要……講我們的專案。抱歉。

lines.say: This is my student Ting. Her project was brilliant. But nobody heard it, because she lost everyone in the first minute.
lines.zh: 這是我的學生小婷。她的專案很棒，但沒人聽進去，因為第一分鐘就把大家搞丟了。

lines.say: The problem wasn't her English. It was that she had no signposts.
lines.zh: 問題不是她的英文，而是她沒有路標。

board.cta: 英文簡報從開場到收尾・12 句

lines.say: Hi everyone, I'm Neev! Today, Ting and I will show you twelve sentences for any presentation.
lines.zh: 哈囉大家，我是 Niamh 老師！今天我和小婷要教你任何簡報都能用的十二句話。
lines.cap: Hi everyone, I'm Niamh! Today, Ting and I will show you twelve sentences for any presentation.

lines.say: A strong start, clear signposts, good answers to hard questions, and an ending people remember.
lines.zh: 有力的開場、清楚的路標、漂亮地回答難題，還有讓人記住的結尾。

scenes.title: Open strong
scenes.sub: 開場：前 30 秒決定一切

lines.say: Part one: open strong.
lines.zh: 第一段：有力的開場。

lines.say: Don't start with sorry, and don't start with em. Start with a plan.
lines.zh: 不要用抱歉開場，也不要用「呃」開場。用一個計畫開場。

scenes.label: No. 1
scenes.phrase: Thanks for coming. I'll keep this short, about ten minutes.
scenes.meaning: 謝謝大家來，我會講短一點，大約十分鐘
scenes.note: keep it short ＝ 長話短說

lines.say: Thanks for coming. I'll keep this short, about ten minutes.
Every audience loves to hear that it will be short. And saying ten minutes makes you sound organised.
lines.zh: 每個聽眾都喜歡聽到「會很短」。說出十分鐘，聽起來很有條理。

lines.say: Then you have to actually finish in ten minutes, of course!
lines.zh: 當然，你就真的要在十分鐘內講完！

lines.say: Now you say it!
lines.zh: 換你說！

lines.say: Thanks for coming. I'll keep this short, about ten minutes.

scenes.label: No. 2
scenes.phrase: By the end, you'll know exactly why our numbers went up.
scenes.meaning: 聽完之後，你會清楚知道我們的數字為什麼上升

lines.say: Then tell them what they'll get.
lines.zh: 接著告訴聽眾他們會得到什麼。

lines.say: By the end, you'll know exactly why our numbers went up.
This is a promise. It gives people a reason to keep listening.
lines.zh: 這是一個承諾，讓大家有理由繼續聽。

lines.say: Think of it as the trailer for your film.
lines.zh: 把它想成電影的預告片。

lines.say: Your turn!
lines.zh: 換你！

lines.say: By the end, you'll know exactly why our numbers went up.

scenes.label: No. 3
scenes.phrase: I've split this into three parts.
scenes.meaning: 我把今天的內容分成三個部分

lines.say: And give the map.
lines.zh: 再給一張地圖。

lines.say: I've split this into three parts.
Split into means divide into. Three is the magic number. People can remember three.
lines.zh: split into 是分成。三是魔法數字，大家記得住三個。

lines.say: Now the audience knows where you're going. They relax.
lines.zh: 聽眾知道你要往哪走，就會放鬆。

lines.say: Now you say it!
lines.zh: 換你說！

lines.say: I've split this into three parts.
Part two: signposts.
lines.zh: 第二段：路標。

lines.say: A signpost is a sentence that says where we are. It's the most useful presentation English there is.
lines.zh: 路標是告訴大家「現在在哪裡」的句子，是最實用的簡報英文。

scenes.label: No. 4
scenes.phrase: Moving on to the second point…
scenes.note: move on to ＝ 進入（下一部分）

lines.say: Moving on to the second point…
Moving on to tells everyone: the last part is finished, here comes the next.
lines.zh: moving on to 告訴大家：上一段結束了，下一段來了。

lines.say: Pause after it. That pause is where people catch up.
lines.zh: 說完停一下，大家會在這個停頓中跟上。

lines.say: Now you say it!
lines.zh: 換你說！

lines.say: Moving on to the second point…

scenes.label: No. 5
scenes.phrase: This is the key point, so I'll say it again.
scenes.meaning: 這是重點，所以我再說一次
scenes.note: the key point ＝ 最重要的一點

lines.say: When something really matters, say so.
lines.zh: 真正重要的事，要明說。

lines.say: This is the key point, so I'll say it again.
The key point means the most important point.
lines.zh: the key point 是最重要的那一點。

lines.say: Repeating it isn't boring. In a talk, it's how people remember.
lines.zh: 重複不無聊。在簡報裡，重複是讓人記住的方法。

lines.say: Your turn!
lines.zh: 換你！

lines.say: This is the key point, so I'll say it again.

scenes.label: No. 6
scenes.phrase: As you can see from this chart, sales nearly doubled.
scenes.meaning: 從這張圖可以看到，銷售幾乎翻倍
scenes.note: As you can see ＝ 如各位所見

lines.say: And when you show a picture, tell them what to look at.
lines.zh: 放圖的時候，要告訴大家看哪裡。

lines.say: As you can see from this chart, sales nearly doubled.
Don't make people read your chart alone. Point at it, and say the one thing that matters.
lines.zh: 不要讓聽眾自己讀圖。指著它，講出最重要的那一件事。

lines.say: Nearly doubled means almost twice as much.
lines.zh: nearly doubled 是幾乎變成兩倍。

lines.say: Now you say it!
lines.zh: 換你說！

lines.say: As you can see from this chart, sales nearly doubled.
Watch Ting again, after one week of practice.
lines.zh: 來看練習一週後的小婷。

lines.say: Thanks for coming. I'll keep this short, about ten minutes. I've split this into three parts.
lines.zh: 謝謝大家來，我會講短一點，大約十分鐘。我把內容分成三個部分。

lines.say: As you can see from this chart, sales nearly doubled. This is the key point, so I'll say it again.
lines.zh: 從這張圖可以看到，銷售幾乎翻倍。這是重點，所以我再說一次。

lines.say: Look at Javier. He's actually listening now!
lines.zh: 看看 Javier，他現在真的在聽了！

lines.say: Part three: questions.
lines.zh: 第三段：問答。

lines.say: This is the scary part for most people. But you only need three sentences.
lines.zh: 這是大部分人最怕的部分。但你只需要三句話。

scenes.label: No. 7
scenes.phrase: That's a great question. Just to check, are you asking about the cost?
scenes.meaning: 好問題。確認一下，你是在問成本嗎？
scenes.note: Just to check ＝ 確認一下

lines.say: That's a great question. Just to check, are you asking about the cost?
Checking the question gives you time to think, and makes sure you answer the right thing.
lines.zh: 確認問題能幫你爭取思考時間，也確保你回答對的東西。

lines.say: If you didn't understand, this is also a polite way to hear it again.
lines.zh: 如果你沒聽懂，這也是請對方再說一次的禮貌方式。

lines.say: Now you say it!
lines.zh: 換你說！

lines.say: That's a great question. Just to check, are you asking about the cost?

scenes.label: No. 8
scenes.phrase: I don't have that figure with me, but I'll email it to you today.
scenes.meaning: 我手邊沒有那個數字，但今天會 email 給你

lines.say: And when you don't know? Never guess.
lines.zh: 如果你不知道呢？千萬不要猜。

lines.say: I don't have that figure with me, but I'll email it to you today.
A figure is a number. With me means here, right now.
lines.zh: figure 是數字，with me 是手邊。

lines.say: Promise a time, and keep it. You'll look more professional than if you'd guessed.
lines.zh: 承諾一個時間，並且做到。這比亂猜看起來專業多了。

lines.say: Your turn!
lines.zh: 換你！

lines.say: I don't have that figure with me, but I'll email it to you today.

scenes.label: No. 9
scenes.phrase: Can we take that one offline? I'd love to talk about it after.
scenes.meaning: 那個問題我們可以會後再談嗎？我很樂意之後聊
scenes.note: take it offline ＝ 會後私下討論

lines.say: And if a question is too long, or off topic, use this.
lines.zh: 如果問題太長，或離題了，就用這一句。

lines.say: Can we take that one offline? I'd love to talk about it after.
Take it offline means discuss it later, outside the meeting.
lines.zh: take it offline 是會後私下討論。

lines.say: I'd love to shows it's not a rejection. You're just protecting everyone's time.
lines.zh: I'd love to 表示你不是拒絕，只是保護大家的時間。

lines.say: Now you say it!
lines.zh: 換你說！

lines.say: Can we take that one offline? I'd love to talk about it after.
Sorry, how much did all this cost?
lines.zh: 不好意思，這些總共花了多少錢？

lines.say: That's a great question. Just to check, are you asking about the cost for this year?
lines.zh: 好問題。確認一下，你是在問今年的成本嗎？

lines.say: Yes, this year.
lines.zh: 對，今年的。

lines.say: I don't have that figure with me, but I'll email it to you today.
lines.zh: 我手邊沒有那個數字，但今天會 email 給你。

lines.say: Perfect, thanks.
lines.zh: 好，謝謝。

lines.say: She didn't know the answer, and it still went perfectly.
lines.zh: 她不知道答案，但一樣很完美。

lines.say: Part four: close it.
lines.zh: 第四段：收尾。

lines.say: Most people end with: em, that's it. Let's do better.
lines.zh: 大部分的人結尾都說：呃，就這樣。我們可以做得更好。

scenes.label: No. 10
scenes.phrase: So, to sum up: three changes, one big result.
scenes.meaning: 總結一下：三個改變，一個大成果

lines.say: So, to sum up: three changes, one big result.
To sum up means to give a short summary of everything.
lines.zh: to sum up 是用一句話總結全部。

lines.say: Make it short enough to fit on a T-shirt.
lines.zh: 短到可以印在 T 恤上。

lines.say: Now you say it!
lines.zh: 換你說！

lines.say: So, to sum up: three changes, one big result.

scenes.label: No. 11
scenes.phrase: If there's one thing I'd like you to remember, it's this.
scenes.meaning: 如果你只記得一件事，我希望是這件
scenes.note: If there's one thing ＝ 如果只有一件事

lines.say: Then give them one thing to take home.
lines.zh: 接著給大家一件可以帶回家的事。

lines.say: If there's one thing I'd like you to remember, it's this.
This sentence makes everyone look up from their phone. Try it.
lines.zh: 這句話會讓每個人從手機上抬起頭。試試看。

lines.say: Then pause, and say your key point one last time.
lines.zh: 然後停頓一下，最後再說一次你的重點。

lines.say: Your turn!
lines.zh: 換你！

lines.say: If there's one thing I'd like you to remember, it's this.

scenes.label: No. 12
scenes.phrase: Thanks for listening. I'm happy to take any questions.

lines.say: And end with a clear signal.
lines.zh: 最後用清楚的信號結束。

lines.say: Thanks for listening. I'm happy to take any questions.
Take questions means answer questions from the audience.
lines.zh: take questions 是回答聽眾的問題。

lines.say: Then smile, and stop talking. Silence after this is normal. Wait.
lines.zh: 然後微笑、停下來。這之後的沉默很正常，等一下。

lines.say: Now you say it!
lines.zh: 換你說！

lines.say: Thanks for listening. I'm happy to take any questions.

scenes.title: Only in Ireland
scenes.sub: 愛爾蘭限定：簡報後聽到的兩句

lines.say: One more thing! Two things you'll hear after a presentation in Ireland.
lines.zh: 還有加碼！在愛爾蘭做完簡報會聽到的兩句話。

lines.say: When you finish and it went well, your colleagues will say this.
lines.zh: 簡報講完又講得好，同事會這樣說。

lines.say: You smashed it!
Smashed it means did it brilliantly. Not broke it!
lines.zh: smashed it 是表現超好，不是把它打破！

lines.say: And when you tell them how nervous you were before, you can say this.
lines.zh: 跟他們說你上台前有多緊張，可以這樣講。

lines.say: I was bricking it.
It's very informal. It means very, very nervous. Only say it to friends!
lines.zh: 很口語，意思是超級緊張。只能跟朋友說！

lines.say: I was bricking it!
One last time, Ting's new presentation. Say her lines with her!
lines.zh: 最後一次，小婷的新簡報。跟她一起唸！

lines.say: Thanks for coming. By the end, you'll know exactly why our numbers went up.
lines.zh: 謝謝大家來。聽完之後，你會清楚知道我們的數字為什麼上升。

lines.say: Moving on to the second point… As you can see from this chart, sales nearly doubled.
lines.zh: 接著進入第二點……從這張圖可以看到，銷售幾乎翻倍。

lines.say: So, to sum up: three changes, one big result. Thanks for listening. I'm happy to take any questions.
lines.zh: 總結一下：三個改變，一個大成果。謝謝聆聽，歡迎提問。

lines.say: Great job, Ting. You smashed it!
lines.zh: 做得好，小婷，你超讚的！

items: Thanks for coming. I'll keep this short, about ten minutes.
By the end, you'll know exactly why our numbers went up.
I've split this into three parts.
Moving on to the second point…
This is the key point, so I'll say it again.
As you can see from this chart, sales nearly doubled.
That's a great question. Just to check, are you asking about the cost?
I don't have that figure with me, but I'll email it to you today.
Can we take that one offline? I'd love to talk about it after.
So, to sum up: three changes, one big result.
If there's one thing I'd like you to remember, it's this.
Thanks for listening. I'm happy to take any questions.

lines.say: From em to smashed it, in one lesson. Well done, Ting, and well done, you!
lines.zh: 一課就從「呃」變成「超讚」。小婷做得好，你也是！

lines.say: Here are all twelve. Screenshot them before your next presentation.
lines.zh: 十二句都在這裡，下次簡報前先截圖。

board.cta: 打開 BinBin，每天用一則新聞練英文

lines.say: I'm Neev. Open BinBin, and practise English with one news story every day.
lines.zh: 我是 Niamh 老師。打開 BinBin，每天用一則新聞練英文。
lines.cap: I'm Niamh. Open BinBin, and practise English with one news story every day.

lines.say: To sum up: practise, signpost, and smile. See you next time. Bye!
lines.zh: 總結一下：練習、路標、微笑。下一課見，Bye！
